items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Prices start at €450 (Start package), landing pages from €350. The final price depends on the number of pages, design and features. Domain and hosting (around €40–60 per year) are paid separately.
It depends on the size of the project and how quickly content (texts, photos) is provided. A small website usually takes a few weeks.

items.q: Can you help with the domain and hosting?
items.a: Yes. If needed, I will help you choose and set up a domain and hosting.

items.q: Will the website work on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every website is built to work on phones, tablets and desktops.
I do the technical SEO basics: metadata, heading structure, sitemap and speed, so your site is ready for further SEO. I don’t guarantee Google rankings — honestly, nobody can.

items.q: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
items.a: It depends on the chosen solution. If you want to edit texts or photos yourself, we will discuss a content management option before starting.

items.q: Can you update my current website?
items.a: Yes. I can modernise your existing website or build a new one, keeping what already works well.

items.q: Do you only work with businesses in Kaunas?
items.a: No. I’m based in Kaunas, so we can meet in person there, but I also work remotely with businesses across Lithuania and abroad.

items.q: Do you maintain the website after launch?
items.a: Yes. Maintenance starts from €25 per month: content changes, updates, backups and help whenever you need it.
